title: brief-lint ui-smoke-warn fires on the bare word 'template' (e.g. 'role templates', 'sprint-config template') — false UI-surface signal
detail: Repro: briefs/deferred-tier-destination.md and briefs/feedback-discoverability.md (2026-10-25) — neither describes a UI surface; both trip [ui-smoke-warn] solely via _UI_SURFACE_RE's \btemplate\b (prusik/brief_lint.py:308) matching 'role templates'/'sprint-config template'. The warning text claims the brief-critic 'would otherwise FAIL on' this, which is misleading noise that trains operators to ignore the warn. 'template' is a weak signal on its own (config/email/doc templates are not rendered UI). Suggest: require a UI-specific co-signal (render/DOM/component/.html/.tsx) or qualify 'template' (html/jinja/view template), with a moat test using these two briefs as negatives.
